vars.prTitle: refactor(lib): getSafeRedirectUrl always resolves to a safe destination
vars.prBody: `getSafeRedirectUrl` already rewrites untrusted origins to the web app root. This applies the same default when no URL is given, so the helper consistently returns somewhere safe to redirect to instead of mixing a fallback URL and `null`. The default is pulled into a constant shared by both paths.
vars.goldenComments: [{"comment": "getSafeRedirectUrl used to return null for a missing URL, and every OAuth callback in app-store relies on that null to fall through to its own destination with `??`. Now an absent `state.returnTo` yields `${WEBAPP_URL}/`, so the right-hand side is never reached: e.g. packages/app-store/hubspot/api/callback.ts:55 `getSafeRedirectUrl(state?.returnTo) ?? getInstalledAppPath({ variant: \"other\", slug: \"hubspot\" })` and packages/app-store/googlecalendar/api/callback.ts:142 now send users to the dashboard root instead of the installed-app page after installing. Worse, the error path in packages/app-store/googlecalendar/api/callback.ts:24-27 (and office365calendar/office365video callbacks) chains `getSafeRedirectUrl(state.onErrorReturnTo) ?? getSafeRedirectUrl(state?.returnTo) ?? ...`: when only returnTo is set, onErrorReturnTo is undefined and now returns the root, so the user's returnTo is ignored. The same pattern is in ~20 callbacks (zoomvideo, salesforce, zohocrm, webex, ...).", "severity": "High"}]
